2607.29071.title: Federated Foundation Models Fine-Tuning with Heterogeneous Compressed Clients
2607.29071.paper_summary: Federated learning of foundation models faces a fundamental resource-asymmetry challenge: the institutions holding the most valuable domain-specific data cannot host billion-parameter models. Existing heterogeneous federated approaches attempt to bridge this gap through parameter-efficient tuning, model pruning, or knowledge distillation, yet each trades away a critical property, whether full-model memory reduction, architectural self-containedness, or representational fidelity, leaving the core tension unresolved. We propose FedSLM, a parameter-centric framework for federated fine-tuning with heterogeneous compressed clients. FedSLM uses SVD-based decomposition to produce self-contained client models, whose low-rank subspaces form nested manifolds that are structurally compatible for aggregation. It then applies a two-stage protocol that synchronizes lightweight adapters within compression groups and fuses full-rank reconstructions across groups via structural alignment. Finally, a weak-to-strong elicitation step with auxiliary confidence loss transfers the aggregated knowledge to the full-scale server, while an explicit bias--variance trade-off mitigates compression artifacts. We provide theoretical guarantees for adapter-level aggregation, subspace-alignment bounds for cross-group fusion, and a characterization of how the confidence loss mitigates weak-supervision noise. Experiments on natural language and vision--language benchmarks show that FedSLM outperforms existing federated baselines under both IID and non-IID partitions, while client models operate at roughly 50% of the GPU memory required by the full model.
2607.29071.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦學習基礎模型面臨一個根本的資源不對稱挑戰：持有最有價值的特定領域數據的機構無法托管十億參數的模型。現有的異質聯邦方法試圖通過參數高效調整、模型剪枝或知識蒸餾來彌補這一差距，但每種方法都犧牲了一個關鍵特性，無論是全模型內存減少、架構自包含性還是表徵保真度，導致核心緊張未得到解決。我們提出了FedSLM，一個針對異質壓縮客戶端的聯邦微調的參數中心框架。FedSLM使用基於SVD的分解來生成自包含的客戶端模型，其低秩子空間形成結構上兼容於聚合的嵌套流形。然後，它應用一個兩階段協議，在壓縮組內同步輕量級適配器，並通過結構對齊在組之間融合全秩重建。最後，一個弱到強的引導步驟與輔助置信損失將聚合的知識轉移到全規模伺服器，同時明確的偏差-方差權衡減輕了壓縮伪影。我們提供了適配器級聚合的理論保證、跨組融合的子空間對齊界限，以及置信損失如何減輕弱監督噪聲的特徵描述。在自然語言和視覺-語言基準上的實驗表明，FedSLM在IID和非IID分區下均超越了現有的聯邦基準，而客戶端模型的運行內存約為全模型所需GPU內存的50%。
